title: Loyalty Finance Calculation Note: Points on a Charged Autoship Shipment (Pals Rewards and Tailwise Plus)
content:
**Subject.** The number of **Pals Rewards and Tailwise Plus** points posted as the missed earning of a charged Tailwise Autoship shipment.

**Formal clause.** The missed-earning points are the shipment's qualifying spend times the missed-earning rate times the points multiplier of the Tailwise Autoship program the shipment belongs to, rounded down to a whole point. The missed-earning rate is the member's base earn rate that the Autoship program's own earning rule multiplies by its points multiplier, stated in points per qualifying dollar; it is the base earn rate of the tier the membership holds. The posted missed-earning points never exceed the per-transaction maximum of the tier held, that cap being applied as the very last step.

**Inputs and where they come from**

| Input | Record |
|---|---|
| Qualifying spend | the shipment's merchandise subtotal less its Autoship discount, as the Tailwise Autoship shipment charge records them, to the cent |
| Processing date | the date of the shipment charge; the posting is dated on it |
| Points multiplier | the figure of the Tailwise Autoship program that the shipment's subscription belongs to |
| Missed-earning rate | the base earn rate of the tier held, in points per qualifying dollar |
| Cap | the per-transaction maximum of the tier held |

**Order of working.** The three quantities are multiplied together first; the product is rounded down once to a whole point; the cap is then applied to the rounded figure.

**Worked figures (hypothetical inputs)**

| | Case A | Case B |
|---|---|---|
| Tier held | Pals Rewards Insider | Pals Rewards Member |
| Merchandise subtotal | $64.99 | $372.40 |
| Autoship discount | $3.25 | $22.40 |
| Qualifying spend | $61.74 | $350.00 |
| Base earn rate of the tier | 10 | 8 |
| Program points multiplier (assumed) | 2 | 2 |
| Spend times rate times multiplier | 1,234.8 | 5,600 |
| Rounded down | 1,234 | 5,600 |
| Per-transaction maximum of the tier | 7,500 | 5,000 |
| Points posted | 1,234 | 5,000 |
